name: @fakhir/ui-workspace
description: Fakhir UI: design tokens (@fakhir/tokens), React components (@fakhir/ui) and the flow and provenance canvas (@fakhir/flow).
author: Natalia Mesquita

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fakhir/tokens && npm run build -w @fakhir/ui && npm run build -w @fakhir/flow
scripts.lint: npm run check:no-tailwind && npm run check:logical-css && npm run check:provenance
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test
